annotations: One layout for every platform: a single column that is the full width on phones and a 640px column on web. The app shells add a three-item tab bar (Home, Book, Clinics); web shows the same three as side navigation.
Booking is three steps with a step counter and no tab bar, so attention stays on the task. The system back button (or browser back) returns to the previous step with choices kept.
Every interactive element is at least 48 × 48 pt. Choices are chips and full-width list rows, never small grids or date pickers.
A way to call the clinic is offered on every error state and whenever online changes aren't allowed.
Nothing times out while the person is typing; the 10-minute hold on a time is shown, and if it lapses the person keeps their details.
Every loading state announces what is loading to screen readers.
assumptions: The clinic diary can return availability for a week at a time quickly enough to feel live
A returning patient's details can be prefilled in the app shells
openQuestions: Should 'Book again with the same physio' appear on Home for returning patients?
Should the cancel sheet ask for a reason (optional), or is that unnecessary data?
